top_concerns: Software/library description with no new method or scientific contribution; weak fit for ICLR main track
Generality claim (all model families, custom architectures) untested: only Gemma3-4B with BTX is evaluated; regex patching admitted to be brittle
BTS and Traditional MoE never evaluated; load-balancing loss and visualizer claims unsupported by evidence
Single case study is a reproduction with confounded baselines (extra SFT/DPO, no MergeKit/Mergoo/weight-averaging comparison, no variance); dense 12B wins on Arabic
No systems evaluation (build time, memory, throughput, latency) despite efficiency motivation; no quantitative comparison with MergeKit/Mergoo
